gizmo.title: Isimo esinamagatsha
gizmo.description: Indaba lapho ukukhetha ngakunye kuholela esigcawini nasesiphethweni esihlukile. Abafundi bangabuyela emuva bazame ezinye izindlela; isiphetho esifinyelelwe sinquma amaphuzu.

configure.title: Isigcawu sokuqala
configure.description: I-ID yesigcawu abafundi abaqala kuso. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uqale esigcawini sokuqala.

advanced.title: Umbala wokugcizelela
advanced.description: Umbala ongakhethwa we-chip yesihloko, izinkinobho nomphetho wokukhetha.
